srList.sentence: Sample size calculation As originally designed, this study required 35 IPC agents per arm (140 IPC agents across four arms) to have 80% power to detect a 30% proportionate difference in VMMC uptake between any two individual arms assuming a high variability between IPC agents (coefficient of variation, k=0.3) (see online supplemental appendix for other scenarios).
